title: Image identification of restriction on an ideal twist
statement: Let $i:X\hookrightarrow Y$ be a closed immersion [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-closed-immersion], $I$ an ideal sheaf on $Y$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], $M$ an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], $m\ge0$, $N=M^{\otimes m}$ and $P=(i^*M)^{\otimes m}$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Choose the module tensor-pullback adjunction [def-pc-module-pullback] with unit $\eta$ and any linear isomorphism $e:i^*N\cong P$. Let $\varphi:i^*I\to\mathcal O_X$ be adjoint to the ideal inclusion followed by the structure-sheaf map, $\mu:I\otimes N\to N$ multiplication, and $\mu_1:\operatorname{im}(\varphi)\otimes P\to P$ multiplication. The image subobject of $\operatorname{im}(\mu)\hookrightarrow N\xrightarrow{\eta_N}i_*i^*N\xrightarrow{i_*e}i_*P$ equals the image subobject of $i_*\operatorname{im}(\mu_1)\xrightarrow{i_*\mathrm{image}.\iota\mu_1}i_*P$. No zero-intersection hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: Remark remark-conductor, final sentence, and the local trivialization argument used in Lemma lemma-dim-1-noetherian-reduced-separated-has-ample

proof.text: Trivialize N=M tensor-power m on an affine basis. For A -> B=A/J and K=I(V), the image of the restriction of the source multiplication image is the quotient ideal (K+J)/J=KB. The adjoint ideal map sends b tensor a to b times the residue of a, so its image is also KB. This does not require K intersection J to vanish. The target product is this ideal times the restricted rank-one module.

The linear isomorphism e carries the product by KB onto the same ideal times its target: apply linearity for one inclusion and linearity of e.inv for the other. Changing adjunction precomposes the adjoint ideal map by an isomorphism and postcomposes the ambient unit by a linear isomorphism; these preserve the ideal image and its product. Quasi-coherent image sections and affine closed-immersion pushforward justify the affine computation. Equality on this basis implies equality of subsheaves by local membership and gluing.

theorem closedImmersion_disjointIdeal_twist_image {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (I : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsInvertible] (m : ℕ)
    (e : (tensorPullback i).obj (M.tensorPow m) ≅
      ((tensorPullback i).obj M).tensorPow m) :
    let adj := Classical.choice (nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction i)
    let φ := (adj.homEquiv I.toModules (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).symm
      (I.toModulesι ≫ SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit i.toRingCatSheafHom)
    let μ := I.toModulesι ▷ M.tensorPow m ≫ (λ_ (M.tensorPow m)).hom
    let μ₁ := image.ι φ ▷ ((tensorPullback i).obj M).tensorPow m ≫
      (λ_ (((tensorPullback i).obj M).tensorPow m)).hom
    imageSubobject (image.ι μ ≫ adj.unit.app (M.tensorPow m) ≫
      (pushforward i).map e.hom) = imageSubobject ((pushforward i).map (image.ι μ₁))
